mapper.select: SELECT * FROM attendance_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND work_date = #{workDate}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO attendance_record (user_id, work_date, check_in_at, check_out_at, status, note, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{workDate}, #{checkInAt}, #{checkOutAt}, #{status}, #{note}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE attendance_record SET check_in_at = #{checkInAt}, check_out_at = #{checkOutAt}, status = #{status}, note = #{note}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
